newsitem.title: USA: Maine lawmakers approve supplemental budget.
newsitem.headline: Maine lawmakers approve supplemental budget.

text.p: Maine lawmakers Thursday approved a $14.6 million supplemental budget that includes $6.7 million for the state's "rainy day" reserve fund.
The package approved Thursday includes $5 million for repairs to state buildings and $1 million for tourism promotion in addition to the reserve fund allocation.
Money for the supplemental budget was made available through higher than anticipated revenues and by transfering unspent funds from other accounts.
The measure is about $10 million less than Gov. Angus King had requested, but lawmakers decided to hold money in "unappropriated reserve" that King had earmarked for spending.
King's spokesman told reporters this week the governor expects to approve the measure despite the changes made by the lawmakers.
